# PoquitoTalk

> 1-Tap Panamanian Spanish WhatsApp Voice Notes Generator for Expats, Travelers, and Service Providers in Bocas del Toro, Panama 🇵🇦.

## Key Capabilities
- **Gemma AI Translation Engine**: Converts English repair and service requests into authentic local Panamanian Spanish phrasing (*"¡Buenas!..."*).
- **WhatsApp Audio Notes**: Generates crisp `.mp3` voice note attachments ready for WhatsApp.
- **1-Tap WhatsApp Integration**: Directly opens native `wa.me` chats with pre-formatted voice clips and text.
- **Local Service Presets**: Built-in scenarios for A/C repair, boat outboard motors, Starlink alignment, plumbing, water delivery, doctors, and landlords.
- **RevenueCat Funnel & Stripe Checkout**: Instant entitlement activation for 100 Credit Packs ($4.99) and Annual Pro Unlimited Passes ($19.99/yr) across web and mobile apps.

## Tech Stack
- **Web Funnel**: HTML5, Vanilla CSS, JS, RevenueCat Web Funnels, Stripe Checkout, Vercel
- **Mobile App**: React Native (Expo v57), RevenueCat Purchases SDK v9, Google Speech-to-Text API, Google Cloud Text-to-Speech API
